(i) the availability of a mechanism that allows to verify the veracity of a rumor is a necessary condition to stop the spread of misinformation; (ii) the probability to forget one's beliefs is another necessary condition; (iii) the spreading rate is not relevant for the eradication of a hoax, but the gullibility of the population is.

a) there is a threshold for the probability of fact checking that guarantees the complete erasure of a hoax from the network, and b) that this threshold does not depend on spreading rate but only depends on the gullibity of the users and their forgetting rate.
